# Richard Tirta

> Richard Tirta Widjaja — senior frontend engineer in San Francisco
> specializing in AI-native and data-heavy user interfaces.
> React/TypeScript/Next.js, data viz with Plotly/D3. Apple (contract),
> Meta, AKQA, Charlotte Russe. Has shipped frontend against MCP
> integration boundaries in an enterprise AI platform, scaled a dashboard
> to 100M+ data points, and builds LLM-powered products end to end. This
> repo is the canonical public context about him; his working repositories
> are private by design.
